resources.string: One a line, as Name: value. Never a password, a cookie or a User-Agent: Tern tells every site that it is Tern.

%1$s offers again what developers publish elsewhere, and is not the developer. Until the app is pinned to a certificate, the first file Tern installs from it decides which certificate every later update must carry.

Paused. Third-party stores are off, so Tern asks this store nothing. Turn them on in Settings to check it again.
Tern does not read sites that offer modified apps. Their files are changed by someone other than the developer and signed by whoever changed them.
Tern cannot read this store without pretending to be its app, so it does not read it.

Third-party stores are off. A store serves its own copies of apps, not files from the developer\'s own site, and Tern reads it through the interface the store made for its own app or website. With them on, Tern asks a store only for the apps you add from it, and until an app is pinned to a certificate, the first file Tern installs from a store decides which certificate its updates must carry.
Turn on Third-party stores in Settings to check this app again.

APKPure, Aptoide, APKCombo, APKMirror, Tencent, Huawei AppGallery, the Galaxy Store and vivo. They serve their own copies of apps, not files from the developer\'s own site, and Tern reads them through the interfaces they made for their own apps and websites. Off, Tern asks none of them anything, a search leaves them out and apps from them are paused.
